freeze_meaning: Stable examined scope, candidate population, source inventory and judgements. Not a claim of universal scholarly consensus, settled uncertainty or validated host adoption.
scope: Independent study of process mining as event data linked to explicit process representations through discovery, conformance, enhancement, organisational/performance analysis, temporal monitoring and related predictive/prescriptive methods; includes responsible use and current object-centric, uncertain, federated and language-assisted frontiers.
scope_boundaries: No requester repositories, runtime designs, previous Evolved packets or sibling outputs used.
No exhaustive census of every publication, commercial product, algorithm variant or industrial deployment.
No normative legal compliance assessment or medical advice; authority/privacy/fairness are analytical boundaries and research concerns.
Original formal-modelling precursors are examined through their explicit use in primary mining papers; some 1998 originals, the full IEEE standard and the monograph have stated access limits.
Current evidence means accessible by 2026-09-06; future issue dates, preprints, conference/journal versions and repeated datasets remain distinct.
The Evolved composition and its analytical probes are not represented as an independently validated academic school or tested organisational implementation.

unresolved_composition_obligations.QUESTION: Would prospective multi-site studies with credible counterfactuals retain the estimated benefit after costs, adverse effects and human adaptation?
Which uncertainty representations remain sound and useful for dynamic object identity relations at realistic scale?
What minimal handoff information reliably prevents semantic overreach without excessive review cost needs field testing.

evidence_limits: 53 works inspected in full-text claim-relevant sections; not a claim that all pages of all 53 works were read. Five additional source records have explicitly narrower access.

S003 and S004: original-work abstracts/metadata only. S015: official IEEE 1849-2023 scope/metadata, not all standard clauses. S051: second-edition monograph metadata/contents. S054: 2025 conference abstract/metadata; distinct 2026 full paper S055 inspected.
Future issue labels are not earlier empirical replications; exact manuscript/preprint versions and access dates are recorded. S028 remains under review at the research cut-off.
Formal validity is bounded by declared models and assumptions. The inspected S043 preprint has an explicitly retained proof-status ambiguity; this packet does not certify the disputed guarantee.

Shared benchmark logs, generators, prefixes, institutions and publication extensions are not independent field replications. 21 empirical records and seven evidence-dependence groups preserve this distinction.

Practitioner reports and industrial examples establish setting-specific experiences or organisational responses, not universal causal benefit. Broad deployed prescription benefit and broad uncertain object-centric transfer remain unresolved in this corpus.

The within-tradition composition and EPM-084 are explicit researcher synthesis. Fourteen analytical probes, including four small executed logical fixtures, are not deployment experiments or empirical validation of the whole system.
Completeness is within the declared scope and examined candidate population; no exhaustive enumeration of all literature, products, methods or deployments is claimed.

verification.verification_limit: Structural/reference/consistency checks and four small analytical fixtures only. These do not verify every scholarly claim, establish evidence saturation independently, run a mining implementation or validate deployment effects. The report contains the substantive research judgements.
verification.substantive_review: Researcher reviewed the composed relationships, non-retained dispositions and all ten domain models before freeze. These human/model analytical judgements are distinguished from automated schema and hash checks.
